commit.message:
Use functools.cached_property

Django 6.2 deprecates django.utils.functional.cached_property.

Add Django 6.1 support

Django 6.1 deprecates SQLCompiler.quote_name_unless_alias() in favour of
quote_name(), which ExtraJoinRestriction used for the content type
restriction; use quote_name() where it exists. Add Django 6.1 to tox and
the classifiers.

Update Python and Django support, enhance workflows, and improve dependencies

- Update Python version in workflows to 3.10 and add support for 3.13 and 3.14
- Update Django support to 5.2 and 6.0, removing support for older versions
- Upgrade pre-commit hooks and dependencies
- Modify installation instructions in README and CONTRIBUTING files
- Add a new test case for prefetching related tags
